40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Add 1 day → total 281 days.  
03-12-1023 + 281 days:  
1023 is not a leap year (divisible by 3, not by 4 in Gregorian rules).  
Days in months remaining in 1023 after Dec 3: Dec has 28 days left (31-3).  
281 − 28 = 253 days left to add, into 1024.  
1024 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → total 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 274 days from Jan 1 to Sep 30.  
253 − 274 = -21 → so date is 21 days before Sep 30, 1024 = Sep 9, 1024.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1024-09-09
